SPIRE1REVAMPED-ACCRETION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] equal to damage dealt.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-ACCRETION.title: Accretion
SPIRE1REVAMPED-AMBIVALENCE.description: Whenever a card is put on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-AMBIVALENCE.title: Ambivalence
SPIRE1REVAMPED-ASCEND.title: Ascend
SPIRE1REVAMPED-AGGREGATE.description: Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each of your Status cards. Transform ALL your status cards into {IfUpgraded:show:Dazed|Void}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-AGGREGATE.title: Aggregate
SPIRE1REVAMPED-BRUTALITY.description:
Every 2 times you lose HP, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-BRUTALITY.title: Brutality
SPIRE1REVAMPED-COALESCE.description:
Gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
Add a copy of this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] that gains an additional {singleStarIcon} and costs an additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-COALESCE.title: Coalesce
SPIRE1REVAMPED-CONCENTRATE.description:
Discard 2 cards and transform them into [gold]Shivs[/gold].
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} equal to their costs.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate
SPIRE1REVAMPED-CRIPPLE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] for each [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] on the enemy.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-CRIPPLE.title: Cripple
SPIRE1REVAMPED-DISARM.description: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, ALL enemies lose 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-DISARM.title: Disarm
SPIRE1REVAMPED-DISCHARGE.title: Discharge
SPIRE1REVAMPED-DROP_KICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
If the enemy is [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], the next card you play is free and [gold]Exhausts[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-DROP_KICK.title: Drop Kick
SPIRE1REVAMPED-EN_GARDE.description:
[gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.
Whenever you play Sovereign Blade, the next card you play is free and [gold]Exhausts[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-EN_GARDE.title: En Garde
SPIRE1REVAMPED-FISSION.description: [gold]Evoke[/gold] all of your Orbs. [gold]Channel[/gold] {Cards:diff()} random {Cards:plural:Orb|Orbs} and draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} for each unique Orb Evoked.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-FISSION.title: Fission
SPIRE1REVAMPED-FLYING_KNEE.title: Flying Knee
SPIRE1REVAMPED-FROM_THE_AETHER.descripti: Whenever you create a card, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-FROM_THE_AETHER.title: From the Aether
SPIRE1REVAMPED-GLASS_KNIFE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Decrease this card's damage by {Decrease:diff()} this combat.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-GLASS_KNIFE.title: Galvanize
SPIRE1REVAMPED-GRIM_REAPER.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Osty[/gold] heals HP equal to damage dealt.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-GRIM_REAPER.title: Grim Reaper
SPIRE1REVAMPED-HEMORRHAGE.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP for each enemy.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-HEMORRHAGE.title: Hemorrhage
SPIRE1REVAMPED-INVIGORATE.description: At the end of your turn, gain {InvigoratePower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-INVIGORATE.title: Invigorate
SPIRE1REVAMPED-KEEPER.description:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
This turn, [gold]Osty[/gold] Attacks are played an extra time.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-KEEPER.title: Keeper
SPIRE1REVAMPED-MASSACRE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} Attack played on the enemy deals {MassacrePower:diff()}% additional damage.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-MASSACRE.title: Massacre
SPIRE1REVAMPED-OMEN.description: The next {OmenPower:plural:time|{OmenPower:diff()} times} a card is played that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] each enemy, double {OmenPower:plural:its effect|their effects}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-OMEN.title: Omen
SPIRE1REVAMPED-OSSIFY.description:
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
[gold]Summon[/gold] from cards is increased by [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-OSSIFY.title: Ossify
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PAIN.description: While in hand, lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP whenever other cards are played.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PAIN.title: Pain
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PREIGNITE.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] the top {Cards:diff()} cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], then play one of them.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PREIGNITE.title: Preignite
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PULSE_OF_LIFE.description: Whenever you play a card, [gold]Osty[/gold] heals {PulseOfLifePower:diff()} HP.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-PULSE_OF_LIFE.title: Pulse of Life
SPIRE1REVAMPED-RAVAGE.description:
Gain {FrailPower:diff()} [red]Frail[/red].
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [red]Vulnerable[/red].
This turn, Attacks gain [gold]Sly[/gold].
Discard {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-RAVAGE.title: Ravage
SPIRE1REVAMPED-RECURSION.title: Recursion
SPIRE1REVAMPED-REINFORCED_FIELD.title: Reinforced Field
SPIRE1REVAMPED-RESORPTION.description: Whenever ANYONE dies, your next [gold]{ResorptionPower:plural:Summon|{ResorptionPower:diff()} Summons}[/gold] from cards {ResorptionPower:plural:is|are} doubled.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-RESORPTION.title: Resorption
SPIRE1REVAMPED-REQUEUE.description:
[gold]Evoke[/gold] your rightmost Orb.
[gold]Channel[/gold] that same Orb.
Add a{IfUpgraded:show: 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}|} [gold]Slimed[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-REQUEUE.title: Requeue
SPIRE1REVAMPED-ROGUE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Discard 1 card.
If it is [gold]Sly[/gold], it is played an extra time.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-ROGUE.title: Rogue
SPIRE1REVAMPED-SETUP.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Add [gold]Sly[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] and put it on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-SETUP.selectionScreenProm: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-SETUP.title: Setup
SPIRE1REVAMPED-VITALITY.description:
[gold]Osty[/gold] heals all missing HP.
ALL enemies lose {Damage:diff()} times that much HP.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-VITALITY.title: Vitality
SPIRE1REVAMPED-VITRIFY.description:
[gold]Channel[/gold] a [gold]Glass[/gold] for each {IfUpgraded:show:of your [gold]Orb Slots[/gold]|[gold]Channeled[/gold] Orb}.
Add 2 [gold]Burns[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
SPIRE1REVAMPED-VITRIFY.title: Vitrify
SPIRE1REVAMPED-WARCRY.description:
Draw 1 card.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-WARCRY.selectionScreenPro: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
SPIRE1REVAMPED-WARCRY.title: Warcry
